summary: List Checklist List Asset Filter Options
description: Returns a page of assets linked to inspections for filtering, each with a key (asset id) and value ("Code - Name" label). Defaults to 100 options per page (maximum 100). Optional query searches linked assets by code or name. Pagination and search are applied by Assets lookup over the full set of linked ids.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of asset filter options to return per page. Defaults to 100. Maximum is 100.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query to filter linked assets by code or name

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Set to 'recycle_bin' to return filter options from deleted inspections

key.description: ID of Checklist List filter object

value.description: Value of Checklist List filter object
